name: @elabs-ai/components-registry-blocks
description: Not a shipped package — a workspace member that exists so the copy-own registry blocks can RESOLVE their own dependencies. Storybook renders these files straight from `registry/blocks/**` (see apps/docs/stories/blocks/), and a tree outside apps/docs cannot reach apps/docs/node_modules; making registry/ a workspace member gives it a real node_modules instead of a parallel list of tsconfig paths and Vite aliases. Every entry below must also appear in some item's derived `dependencies` in registry.json — asserted by scripts/gen-registry.test.mjs.
